clip.hook: FNS: OPEN QUALIFIERS WILL BE A MESS
clip.notes: Open qualifiers in the new circuit will be plagued by tech issues. in_point 2.02 drops the dangling "in the new circuit i already said this" so the clip opens on a complete clause and the claim lands ~3s in instead of 9.5s.  booms named rather than ranked: George said "ping issues, cheaters there should be zooms because it's when he's loud", and that moment (9.30) ranks THIRD by level (+3.54) behind 22.57 (+3.96) and 34.19 (+3.72). At a 2-boom budget the automatic pick drops it. 22.57 keeps the loudest; 34.19 is the one given up, and no verdict exists on either.  booms override CLEARED ([9.3, 22.57]): the nucleus gate reaches the same answer on its own, so naming it would hide whether the logic works.
